label: The wake-up energy
subgoals: Compute the charge needed to restore the rail
Multiply by the supply voltage to get the energy drawn
Split it into stored and dissipated halves

label: Break-even sleep time
subgoals: Find the leakage saved during sleep
Divide the wake-up energy by it
Convert nanojoules over microwatts to microseconds

label: Net energy over an interval
subgoals: Multiply the saved leakage power by the sleep time
List the latency, rush current and IR costs not in the sum
